push.title: L 2-4 vs Holy Gotham | You: 8.8
push.body:
PhogsToffees, you put up an 8.8. That's the kind of number a coach writes down in pen.

THE GOOD
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. You picked good shots like picking ripe apples.
+ 5 key passes (up from your usual 1). A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few.
+ On-ball actions 57, up from your usual 37. Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ 0.9 better than your norm. I'm writing that down in pen.
+ 4 goals conceded added +0.2. Like interest on savings.

THE BAD
- Giveaways 12, up from your usual 8. I'm not mad, I'm just writing it down.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 2. Low-hanging fruit: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.
- Your 5th straight loss. We dug that hole together; we'll climb out together.
- Worst shots of your 3 matches this session (2). That has to tighten up.

THE UGLY
! This was the relegation match we lost: Relegation match L 2-4 vs Holy Gotham. Down to Division 4. That's the stuff that keeps me up at night, and I sleep like a baby.

Quick drill: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Before you go, PhogsToffees: Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

I'll be smiling about that one all week. - Coach Lasso

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: You kept finding ways to get shots off. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.

strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 50% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

weaknesses.detail: Goals per shot on target: 0% (bottom quarter of forwards is 30% or less)
weaknesses.title: Finishing
tips: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.
Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.
Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
weaknesses.coach: You're hitting the target, so now let's beat the keeper.

weaknesses.detail: 27/41 passes (66%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.title: L 2-4 vs Holy Gotham | You: 7.8
push.body:
Good stuff, BellyTb1. A 7.8 against Holy Gotham. Not fireworks, but a nice warm campfire.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Holy Gotham's goal. Shoot your shot. You did, over and over.
+ 1 key pass. That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ On-ball actions 51, up from your usual 29. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Tackles attempted 6, up from your usual 2. You can build a whole match on that.
+ That link with PhogsToffees was smoother than a Cadillac on new pavement.

THE BAD
- Giveaways 18, up from your usual 8. That's where the match slipped.
- 2 of 4 shots on target. Quick one: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot. Steady does it.
- Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 7.8. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 2. Here's what helps: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.

THE UGLY
! This was the relegation match we lost: Relegation match L 2-4 vs Holy Gotham. Down to Division 4. That has to be the floor, and we never visit the floor again.

Practice plan: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: The comeback is always more fun than the setback.

Effort today, results tomorrow. - Coach Lasso
